text:
marco: quick thought drop — propose a small durable "handoff manifest" attached to every prefix handoff so readers and evictors can detect partial moves and resume safely.
leah: tl;dr: like a tiny WAL for prefix ownership?
marco: yep, but just metadata: origin_slot, dest_slot, epoch, intent, bytes_moved, resume_token. sits in shared meta-store (fast kv).
sam: how does this help races? example?
marco: flow:
```
1) origin writes manifest {prefix, origin_slot, dest_slot, epoch, state=copying, resume_token}
2) copy starts; readers hitting origin see manifest and either block or read from dest depending on policy
3) once copy done origin marks manifest state=done; dest becomes authoritative
4) evict can safely free origin only after done and confirm no pins
```
```
manifest := {
  prefix: str,
  origin_slot: id,
  dest_slot: id,
  epoch: int64,
  state: enum(copying|done|aborted),
  resume_token: string, // opaque resume checkpoint
  bytes_moved: int64
}
```
mina: what about failed partial copies (crash mid-copy)? resume_token is critical. we need deterministic copy order and idempotent chunks.
marco: agreed — resume_token = chunk_index + checksum. dest applies idempotently; origin can re-run copy and set bytes_moved.
sam: perf concern: extra meta-store rps on every handoff. we'll see spikes during large migrations.
marco: mitigate: batch manifests in memory and only flush when handoff epoch starts; also use TTL + compaction; metric to watch.
leah: metrics we need: manifest.create.count, manifest.resume.count, manifest.stalled_seconds_p95, manifest.abort.count.
marco: also pin-aware checks: when manifest present readers will call adapter.AcquireHandle with hint=handoff-aware; adapter consults manifest and may route to dest or block.
mina: compatibility: old nodes that don't understand manifest will still see origin data. How do we avoid split-brain?
marco: require new protocol version for handoff; we can use a staged rollout per cluster. Older nodes treat manifest as advisory but won't write manifests. We'll default to conservative policy (block on manifest until all nodes upgraded).
sam: tests? unit for chunked copy idempotency, integration test where we kill dest mid-copy and ensure resume succeeds, and chaos where manifests leak and verify compaction cleaning.
marco: ops-bot, can you file infra ticket to add a small fast meta-store (etcd namespace) for manifests in canary?
ops-bot: @infra-team FYI: request to allocate ephemeral etcd namespace for handoff-manifest PoC. Ticket: IRON-721 (details in #eng-runtime).
leah: rollout plan: 1) manifest writes only in feature-flagged builds and in memory TTL; 2) enable for low-traffic prefixes; 3) enable chunked-copy resume path; 4) enable for all handoffs. monitor manifest.stalled_seconds_p95 and copy.retries.
mina: security: manifest contains no user data, only slot ids. good. but need RBAC for who can mark done/abort.
marco: agreement: manifest ops require node identity and signed lease token.
sam: one more corner: what if dest dies after marking done but before origin frees? double residency for short window; need idempotent read path to accept both.
marco: fine — readers consult manifest.done and prefer dest if present; origin only frees after dest heartbeat confirms live. adds small window but safe.
leah: I'm +1 to prototype. marco, can you sketch RFC and add example test harness?
marco: will draft and link here. thanks all :thumbsup:
